carla.name: Coach-Mom Carla
carla.job: Help my child enjoy becoming more capable.
carla.objection: Injury, aggression, wasted commitment, schedule fit.
carla.proof: Visible coaching, suitable partners, real local families.
carla.visual_brief: Show coached youth games and willing participation; avoid staged distress.
carla.offer_path: Youth free visit → appropriate first class → youth program discussion.
carla.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

ben.name: Beginner Ben
ben.job: Start learning grappling at a manageable pace.
ben.objection: Being inexperienced, fitness, injury, hard rounds.
ben.proof: Coach involvement, normal beginners, clear first-visit expectations.
ben.visual_brief: Show ordinary adults learning with a coach; avoid only tournament intensity.
ben.offer_path: Adult free visit → coached class scheduled afterward → adult program discussion.
ben.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

ian.name: Independent Ian
ian.job: Move, play, solve a challenge, and want to return.
ian.proof: Enjoyment, familiar partners, small observable achievements.
ian.visual_brief: Real games, escapes, fist bumps; no dangerous-kid framing.
ian.offer_path: Experience lens on Carla concepts; follow up with the guardian, not the child.
ian.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

tyler.name: Cross-Training Tyler
tyler.job: Learn another physical skill between sports seasons.
tyler.objection: Another commitment, looking childish, mismatched partners.
tyler.proof: Age-appropriate partners and controlled skill practice.
tyler.visual_brief: Show teens training with teens where possible; no little-kids creative.
tyler.offer_path: Youth free visit → appropriate coached class → schedule fit discussion. The 2–3-session trial is a proposed pilot only.
tyler.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

casey.name: Community Casey
casey.job: Make time for a challenging activity outside work.
casey.proof: Current eligibility, transparent terms, real coaching.
casey.visual_brief: Ordinary adult training; do not infer someone is a nurse or officer from a photo.
casey.offer_path: Adult free visit → verify eligible service category → community adult program.
casey.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

frankie.name: Family-Activity Frankie
frankie.job: Find a worthwhile activity that fits the household.
frankie.objection: Extra trips, incompatible times, assuming a shared class exists.
frankie.proof: Accurate schedules and a clear explanation of separate age groups.
frankie.visual_brief: Only use parent-child training photos to imply a shared session if that service exists.
frankie.offer_path: Family inquiry → plan appropriate classes for each person. Shared mixed-age class is unverified.
frankie.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.

wendy.name: Weekend Wendy
wendy.job: Keep training while visiting the Catskills.
wendy.objection: Unclear availability, partner fit, parking, membership pressure.
wendy.visual_brief: Adult training or actual room; avoid promising particular partners.
wendy.offer_path: Day pass / vacation week inquiry → confirm date and fit → visit; packs only for repeat travel.
wendy.evidence_status: User-supplied strategic hypothesis; not a validated demographic model.
